You own ONLY: scripts/ringer/stage7/door_transition.py (NEW), scripts/ringer/stage7/test_door_transition.py (NEW), scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py, scripts/ringer/stage7/check_door_probe.py. Touch nothing else (not storygame/*, data/*, bench/frozen/*, bench/variations/*, test_door_probe.py, door_continuation.py). The door, source, completion and grounded experiments must stay byte-for-byte reproducible and their existing tests must pass unchanged.

READ FIRST: .plans/astra-2a-grounded-transition-prereg.md (the design you implement; it is authoritative), scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py (live_run, dry_run, _continue, _ask_player, EXPERIMENTS, main), door_continuation.py (score_command, which already supports clarifies/target_reveal), door_transport.py (SpendBudget), check_door_probe.py, door_ask_player.mjs, and storygame/runtime/engine.py turn()/_deadline_transition_cause and attempt_bundle.py (AttemptBundle.transition_cause is one of none/earned/forced/timer; engine.last_attempt is the latest bundle).

GOAL. A new experiment 'transition' that reuses the grounded experiment's arms, variations, recorded 2A prompts and screen construction but, instead of at most two commands, runs a FULL 2B continuation per row until the scene exits, as the prereg's 'Procedure per row' says.

IMPLEMENT (test-first):
1. door_transition.py: a function run_continuation(variation_path, first_command, screen, budget, max_commands=20, ask_player=_ask_player-like callable injected for tests) that builds the 2B state exactly as door_probe._continue does (package_and_state(variation,'2B'), provider_for, semantic_ask=None, counted_provider, RuntimeEngine), then loops: score each command with a plain engine.turn (reuse door_continuation.score_command with clarifies/clarification_round when the previous turn was a clarification, no target_reveal), read engine.last_attempt.transition_cause and state.current_scene_id after every non-clarification turn, stop when current_scene_id != '2B', state.story_complete, or the command count reaches max_commands. After each non-final turn ask the raw player for the next command with a transcript that ACCUMULATES: screen + for each turn '\n\n> <command>\n<response>' (keep the existing player API: payload {'transcript', 'status'}). Return per-row fields exactly: final_scene, ended_by (cause of the exit turn, or 'none' if the row never left 2B), transition_turn (1-based command number or None), commands (list), responses (list), clarification_turns (list of 1-based command numbers), committed_reveals_by_turn (list of lists), panel_named (True if any command contains 'panel', case-insensitive), turn_statuses, request_count, recovery_count. Never retry or replace a sample: any NarrationProviderError or player error propagates and stops the run.
2. door_probe.py: register EXPERIMENTS['transition'] with arms/variations from PROMPT_EXPERIMENTS['grounded'] and GROUNDED_VARIATIONS, caps {1: {'raw': 2, 'cloudflare': 40, 'player': 36}, 12: {'raw': 24, 'cloudflare': 480, 'player': 408}}, and wire it into main/dry_run/live_run with minimal branching (reuse build_source, the grounded prompt patching, raw 2A request and the screen construction unchanged; replace only the _continue call and the row fields). Dry run must write the same artifact set as the grounded dry run plus the planned max_commands, without any network or player call. Rows in live mode additionally carry the fields from item 1 and row-level 'earned_exit' (ended_by == 'earned'), 'timer_exit' (ended_by in forced/timer), 'no_exit' (ended_by == 'none'). The summary gains per-arm counts of earned_exit, timer_exit, no_exit and the cap arithmetic. The CLI must keep requiring --confirm for live runs.
3. check_door_probe.py: support --experiment transition in dry and artifacts modes: validate row fields and types, ended_by in {earned, forced, timer, none}, consistency (earned_exit/timer_exit/no_exit mutually exclusive and matching ended_by; transition_turn None iff ended_by == 'none'; len(commands) == len(responses)+0 or +1 as your loop produces, document which), spend events within caps, and per-arm summary counts equal to recounts from rows.
4. test_door_transition.py (hermetic, stub engine/provider/player, no network): (i) exits earned on turn 3 -> ended_by earned, transition_turn 3, commands length 3; (ii) a forced exit is classified forced and counted timer_exit; (iii) 20 commands without leaving 2B -> no_exit, loop stops at 20, no 21st player call; (iv) clarification turn: next command is scored with clarifies=<original> and clarification_turns recorded; (v) the transcript passed to the player grows with each turn and contains earlier commands and responses; (vi) a provider/player error propagates and no row is fabricated; (vii) EXPERIMENTS['transition'] caps match the numbers above and other experiments are unchanged; (viii) dry-run artifacts validate with the checker.
VERIFY: .venv/bin/python -m pytest scripts/ringer/stage7 -q -n0 (all existing stage7 tests stay green, count them before/after); .venv/bin/ruff check and .venv/bin/ruff format --check on the four owned files; for E in grounded completion source: dry run + checker as in earlier manifests still validate; for transition: rm -rf /tmp/tr-dry && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py --n 1 --experiment transition --dry-run --out /tmp/tr-dry && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/check_door_probe.py /tmp/tr-dry 1 --mode dry --experiment transition. Final message: files changed, test counts, deviations from the prereg (there should be none).
